description.value: Milestones is a Canadian bar-and-grill chain offering familiar North American cuisine with a refined twist, operating out of a two-storey retail building on Barnet Highway in Coquitlam. The restaurant features a full sit-down dining room and bar, making it a reasonable stop for a meal after a ride through the Tri-Cities area. Online ordering and delivery are supported, indicating takeout is also an option.
